verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows Cloud Firestore supports KNN vector search (firebase-docs-11/19/35), not full-text search, and community feedback repeatedly flags Firebase's weak native querying (firebase-comm-8, firebase-comm-18, firebase-comm-19 on lacking count/advanced queries). No documentation describes an in-house full-text search capability that would avoid needing an external service like Algolia/Elasticsearch.
